role.zh: 怪物炮击步兵 · T4 · 短程破甲炮击，被近身时金棒反打
role.en: Monstrous cannon infantry · T4 · short-range armour-piercing cannon fire, and a kanabo for anyone who gets too close

desc.zh: 体魄异常魁梧的高大鬼族，单人即可擎起通常需数人操持的国崩大筒，以近距轰鸣的狂暴炮火与恐怖蛮力粉碎敌阵。
desc.en: Towering oni of prodigious strength wield Kunikuzushi cannon alone, shattering enemy ranks with close-range cannon fire and brute force.

story.zh: 鬼族是尼朋妖怪中最为强横壮硕的一支，而其中那些血脉最为沉厚、体魄格外庞大的魁伟巨鬼，身高可近三米，动辄便有拔木裂石的惊人蛮力。
story.en: The oni are among the mightiest of Nippon's yokai. Those in whom the ancient blood runs strongest grow into hulking giants, standing almost three metres tall and possessed of the strength to uproot trees and split stone.

story.zh: 尼朋曾经引入模仿旧世界的火器，仿铸名为「国崩」的重型大筒。这类火炮管壁厚重、后坐力极猛，寻常人类往往需要两到三名精壮炮手协力垫土筑台、推挽操架方能勉强击发。然而对于巨鬼而言，沉重的国崩大筒在他们粗壮如铁的双臂间不过如同随身手铳般自如，单人便能端起大筒在行进间抵近直射，实心生铁巨弹瞬间便能将敌军与城垛轰成齑粉。
story.en: When firearms from the Old World reached Nippon, its smiths cast heavy cannon in their likeness and named them Kunikuzushi. With thick barrels and a savage recoil, these guns could scarcely be fired without two or three stout men working together to bank up earth, build a platform and heave the carriage into place. Yet in the iron arms of a giant oni, a Kunikuzushi handles as easily as a hand cannon. A single warrior can carry it forward and fire at close quarters, its great balls of cast iron pounding soldiers and battlements alike into dust.

v.zh: 怪物步兵 · 远程（兼顾近战）
v.en: Monstrous infantry · missile (also handy in melee)

v.zh: 大筒「国崩」（实心炮弹，破甲为主）＋金棒
v.en: Kunikuzushi cannon (solid shot, mostly armour-piercing) and kanabo

v.zh: 不着甲，皮糙肉厚（护甲 50）；无盾
v.en: No armour worn, just thick hide (armour 50); no shield

v.zh: ① 地标「晓行之里」三级「鬼灯楼」（御神木）；② 旗舰「晓行寮」链行 IV「鬼灯舱」（伊吹入队后解锁）；③ 经伊吹的同伴面板以名望征召
v.en: ① The Dawnbreakers' Haven landmark at the Sacred Tree, tier 3 building Tower of Oni Lanterns; ② the Oni Lantern Deck, row IV of the Dawnbreakers' Quarters chain aboard the flagship (available once Ibuki has joined); ③ bought with Renown through Ibuki on the Expedition Companions panel

v.zh: ① 御神木定居点 3 级并建成鬼灯楼；② 伊吹入队后旗舰提督居所升到行 IV 并建成鬼灯舱；③ 伊吹任务链第叁章「野太刀『无名』」完成（伊吹 12 级）
v.en: ① The Sacred Tree at settlement level 3, with the Tower of Oni Lanterns built; ② once Ibuki has joined, upgrade the flagship's Admiral's Residence to open row IV and build the Oni Lantern Deck; ③ completing Ibuki's Chapter III, "The Nameless Odachi" (Ibuki at rank 12)

v.zh: ①② 无上限；③ 第叁章解锁、容量 1，第肆章 +3（其中 1 队直接入列），总容量 4；每队 6 名望
v.en: ①② none; ③ capacity 1 from Chapter III and +3 from Chapter IV (one of them joins outright), 4 in all; 6 Renown per unit

v.zh: 鬼灯楼：新募等级 +1、招募成本 −15%、维持费 −5%（全阵营）；鬼灯舱：新募等级 +1、维持费 −10%（本军）；两处可叠加
v.en: Tower of Oni Lanterns: +1 rank for new recruits, recruitment cost -15%, upkeep -5% (faction-wide); Oni Lantern Deck: +1 rank for new recruits, upkeep -10% (this army); the two stack

cth_npex_ability_kunikuzushi_brace.zh: 手动、仅自身：44 秒内远程破甲伤害 ×1.4、物理抗性 +20%，期间无法移动；冷却 90 秒
